import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

def task_func(array_length=100):
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

    if not isinstance(array_length, (int, np.integer)):
        raise TypeError("array_length must be an integer.")
    if array_length <= 0:
        raise ValueError("array_length must be a positive integer.")

    # Generate two arrays of random numbers
    array1 = np.random.random(array_length)
    array2 = np.random.random(array_length)

    # Compute statistics
    statistics = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "Array1": [
                np.mean(array1),
                np.median(array1),
                np.std(array1),
            ],
            "Array2": [
                np.mean(array2),
                np.median(array2),
                np.std(array2),
            ],
        },
        index=["Mean", "Median", "Standard Deviation"],
    )

    # Draw bar chart comparing the statistics
    ax = statistics.plot(kind="bar", figsize=(8, 5))
    ax.set_xlabel("Statistics")
    ax.set_ylabel("Value")
    ax.set_title("Comparison of Array Statistics")
    ax.legend(title="Arrays")
    plt.tight_layout()

    return statistics, ax
